_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Snapshot compiled 2026-09-26 from cited public records. Los Zetas and Cártel del Noreste are modeled separately because the post-2015 split also produced other factions; CDN is a successor faction, not every former Zetas member. Roles and legal status are time-bound to source dates; charges and sanctions do not establish conviction. Public senior figures only, country-level regions only, no operational routes or enforcement gaps. No photos included because reuse rights were not verified.

sources.title: Leaders of Los Zetas Arraigned on Drug Trafficking, Firearm, and Money Laundering Charges
